verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents telephony transports and inbound carrier webhooks, and Pipecat Cloud advertises unlimited concurrency. None of the evidence describes batch outbound dialing, campaign scheduling, or per-campaign throughput or pacing controls. Concurrency capacity and inbound call handling are adjacent features, not the campaign capability this story asks about.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls
